sections.title: Anomalies & Execution Rules
sections.pedagogicalObjective: Identify volume anomalies and actionable execution protocols.
keyPoints: Low volume rallies indicate bull traps.
Physical clearing volume cannot be hidden.

misconceptions.misconception: Assuming that breakout price movement alone confirms strong institutional demand.
misconceptions.authorRebuttal: Anna Coulling explains that price movement without high volume represents an engineered trap by insiders.

activeRecallQuiz.scenario: A trader observes a strong 3.5% breakout candle in Chapter 5 Part 2, but the underlying volume bar registers at a 20-day low. The trader must determine if this breakout represents authentic institutional accumulation.
activeRecallQuiz.question: Why does a wide spread upward price breakout accompanied by unusually low transaction volume signal an insider trap rather than authentic institutional buying?
activeRecallQuiz.correctAnswer: Because volume represents physical capital effort; low volume proves smart money is not buying and insiders are marking up quotes to lure retail buyers.
activeRecallQuiz.explanation: In Volume Price Analysis, volume validates effort. An upward price surge on low volume reveals lack of institutional sponsorship and warns of an imminent reversal.

coreTakeaways: Volume is the ultimate truth detector that validates candlestick price action.
Always demand high volume confirmation before trusting any trend breakout.
Align your positions with institutional smart money rather than fighting the tape.
